'''2012 Bespin Regionals Jake Nelson LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jake Nelson]] at [[2012 Bespin Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
